verdict.rationale: Summer Engine's own docs say it builds games for desktop (Windows, Mac, Linux), mobile (iOS, Android) and the web, and that they can launch on Steam, iOS or Android. That covers the desktop and mobile parts of the story. There is no evidence of console export, either directly or through partners, and nothing explicitly shows a single project targeting all platforms at once. missing for 10: console export (direct or via partners), explicit single-project multi-platform export documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of exports.

support.subject: As a studio lead, one project exports to desktop, mobile, and (directly or via partners) consoles

citations.quote: Make games for Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS, Android and the web.
Make real 2D and 3D games with Summer Engine that you can launch on Summer Games, Steam, iOS or Android.
